people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: You shall set your face toward the siege of Jerusalem, with your arm uncovered; and you shall prophesy against it.
translations.bsb: You must turn your face toward the siege of Jerusalem with your arm bared, and prophesy against it.
translations.kjv: Therefore thou shalt set thy face toward the siege of Jerusalem, and thine arm shall be uncovered, and thou shalt prophesy
translations.asv: And thou shalt set thy face toward the siege of Jerusalem, with thine arm uncovered; and thou shalt prophesy against it.
